mechanics.claim: Despair is a toggled aura that deals damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies while active, costing mana per second, rather than being cast once.
mechanics.quote: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Amumu''' cries a continuous pool of tears, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies.

mechanics.claim: Despair turns off automatically if Amumu cannot pay its mana cost, stopping the damage tick.
mechanics.quote: ''Despair'' is toggled off automatically if '''Amumu''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.

mechanics.claim: Toggling Despair does not count as an ability activation, so it does not trigger on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: Toggle abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Despair's tooltip rounds its health-percent damage, but the true AP scaling is finer-grained (+0.0025% per 1 AP) than the displayed rounding suggests.
mechanics.quote: Despite the rounding in ''Despair's'' tooltip, it will deal increased damage for every point of {{tt|ability power|+0.0025% per 1 AP}}.
